Come weekend, on Sunday evening 6 PM, Dhika after hugging bye to John, Pappu and Aunty...... and the Twins saying byes to their parents, the 3 entered through,... for security checks at the airport.
It only took a few minutes, and by then, they were sitting in the waiting area,... ready to board their flight.....

Last week went very fast for Dhika... She took leaves, and spend a couple of days with her in laws and then a couple of days with her parents.... Both she and John decided to leave Pappu with her parents while she will be away, abroad. John decided to stay in their own apartment, due to work.

Sitting in the waiting area, Dhika was feeling very sad and looked like at the verge of crying.... She had never travelled anywhere abroad alone without John, and leaving Pappu was being very hard for her.......

Initially, none really spoke much with each other,..... with Bantu on his ear pods,.... Dhika sitting and looking outside at the landing flights,... while Bobby was the only one out of the twins who noticed Dhika was sad......... He understood why she may be so, and he wanted to do something and cheer her...... He knew Dhika liked donuts, so he went and brought a few donuts from Krispy Kreme,...... and they both enjoyed it while Bantu dosed off to sleep.
Soon it was time for boarding and everyone started getting ready...... Dhika and twins made a pre check-in online and chose a 3 seater centre row, so that they all can sit together....
Dhika sat in between, with twins at her either side....
The flight took off at 9 PM.......... and they had a looonggg journey ahead of them......
They were all very tired due to all last minute traveling and packing.... So, as soon as they ate the served dinner, they all slipped off to a tiring sleep.
Somewhere around 7- 8 hours later, she woke up.......

Dhika noticed that the boys were still asleep and both were sleeping at each of her shoulders.... Not wanting to wake them up,... she just quietly started watching movies. She liked the feel of them laying at each of her shoulders.
The boys too woke up soon,... and the rest of the flight was pretty much boring... the chatted, watched movies,...all the while enjoying the fight savories....
Around 8 AM local time in the morning, they reached Geneva, Switzerland.
The concierge lady appointed to receive them was waiting for them. She was at the arrivals gate, holding out their name cards.
Dhika: Hi...... she approached her,.. I'm Dhika, from India.
Stacy: Hiiiii, she gave a broad smile,........ I am Stacy, welcome to Switzerland... how was your flight ?
They all exchanged pleasantries, and she personally welcomed Dhika, Bantu and Bobby with a warm hug....... Asking about their Journey and how were things in India,.... she took all 3 towards her car.
Stacy: I will be your point of contact while you stay here. Feel free to ask me any help you want... I am here to assist you. I will make sure you enjoy your stay.
They all reached the parking lot...... and Stacy opened the trunk for them, while the boys started loading their baggage....
And,.........Bantu dropped a bag down, with a loud noise.....
Dhika couldn't concentrate,... can you... she asked him quietly.... giggling.
Bantu: hehe... shuuuuu

It wasn't Bantu's fault that he dropped the bag,... the Swiss lady was so cute to keep his eyes off of her..... She was very cute and tall, and fit.... with very small breasts but an ass to kill for... She was in her gym clothes wearing a small white full-handed T shirt with a sports bra inside and a tight gym pants,.. which made her long, slender legs to reveal its structure....
Hearing the loud noise... she came back, from the front... to help Bantu......
Stacy: Looking at him, checking her attire........Sorry, I am in my gym clothes, I thought I had time before I pick you, but, well you can see, I was wrong. She gave an awkward smile.
Bantu: Its no problem... you are looking good in it..
Stacy: ohhh,..... thank you.. aren't you sweet....
They all got into the car and she started driving them towards their stay.......
Bobby: When will we be visiting the project ?... he asked excited...

Stacy: Oh, Bobby, that will be tomorrow morning at 11 AM. Of your stay of 5 days here,.... you will be visiting the office for 3 days and your visiting hours will be from 11 AM to 4 PM...... and the rest of the time is for you to enjoy and spent as you wish....
Bantu: Will you be coming to pick us up daily... he asked sheepishly.... giving a child like naughty look at Dhika.
Stacy: uh, No Bantu.... The office car will be coming to pick and drop you. But I stay in the city,... If at all you need me, give me a call and I will be there.
Stacy: I have already arranged everything that you may need. Food at the hotel, and you can even cook your own food if you like. I managed to store some groceries in your suite's kitchen.
Dhika: Is our stay near your place Stacy... she asked politely.....
Stacy: Oh, no Dhika. First I thought that would be better,... but then I booked a stay for you guys in a small place at the outskirts of the city.... It is much more beautiful over there...

Soon, the car left the city and the view was breathtaking..... Their hotel was situated a little far from the city crowd,... but in a stunning location... There was a small stream of water running across the green grass valley, in front of the hotel.....
Stacy: Here is the key card... your room is on the top floor, the prime suite..... enjoy your stay. she said smiling....
Stacy once again welcomed them,....... and hugging them.. she prepared to leave them to rest.
Stacy: Oh, one important matter.... There is a weather forecast that there will be heavy rainfall, with thunderstorm over next 3 - 4 days.... So, please be prepared and safe.....
Saying that she will meet them tomorrow at the office,... she turned back and proceeded towards the car......
Dhika: oi.... both of you stop staring at her bum...hehe.....
Both Bobby and Bantu were open mouthed at how perfect her bum cheeks looked in the tight gym pants....
Author's Note: This character is just one time,... and she won't be appearing again....
They reached the top floor and Bobby opened the room for them..... As soon as Dhika entered the suite... she felt both amazed,....... and a worried at the same time.....

She was surprised that there was only one bedroom... She was really expecting two bedrooms like a 2BHK,....... atleast that's what she misunderstood as... when the email said suite... She thought to herself that she should have checked before......
The boys too noticed it... and both looked at Dhika blinking....
Bantu: miss... you can take bed... we both will share the sofa....
Dhika: oh dear... don't be ridiculous... I will take the sofa,.... you both can sleep on the bed...... she smiled faintly.....
Apart from that, the room was anything but amazing... It was indeed a suite, but like a Studio Condo,.... with an open floor plan...

It was a large room with a huge king bed on one side....... and a living area in the middle with one big 3 seater sofa facing the TV... and on the other side of the living room was a small kitchen with a kitchen table top..... To the right side of the bed,.... was a big balcony opening to the green mountains...
Dhika also saw a small dressing room, connected to the huge bathroom, with a huge shower stall,..... that looked like it can easily accommodate 4 people together....

Soon, the boys threw the baggage to one corner of the room, and jumped on the bed and in no time,.. went to sleep....while Dhika put her luggage in the dressing room and settled in the sofa, relaxing her legs.... The sofa was more than comfortable enough and soon,...... she too drifted to sleep....
Around 2 PM in the afternoon,
Dhika was feeling hungry after getting up and she forced the boys to get up too... and they all enjoyed a nice Swiss style lunch.....
Sitting in the sofa, they ate, watching the movie... "Zindagi na milegi dobara". Bantu had it in his mobile, and he was able to cast it to the TV.
Dhika had not watched this movie... and upon a good review from Bobby,... she said lets watch, and they started watching......

During on of the scenes.... A guy meets a Spanish girl,.... and when she is in the bathroom taking a shower... he just knocks the door and asks "Puedo mi entrar, por favor"... to which she just takes a minute without responding anything.... but then a minute later,... she just opened the door for him...... to let him join her, in the shower.
Dhika: hehehehe.... he just met her....but he asked and she let him in.....
Bantu: hehe.... yes.. nice na.... lucky fellow
Dhika: hehe.... it don't happen like that in real life dear.....
All laughed and enjoyed the rest of the movie with a lot of comments and discussions....

Soon the movie was over,... and Dhika was in the dressing room, arranging her dresses in the wardrobe,.. while the boys were standing in the balcony enjoying the view... It was a pleasant evening,... with a nice tad warm weather.... Nothing of sorts looked like it may rain as Stacy warned....
Bobby: calling to Dhika, miss... shall we go outside ?
Dhika: sure dear.... I was thinking the same....
While Dhika and Bobby were discussing where to go....
Bantu: coming inside... so miss... ready for the first dress..... he gave a mischievous smile....
Dhika: hehe... what?....... I thought you guys were kidding....
Bobby: oh, we bought a couple of dresses for you miss... he said quietly...smiling...
Dhika: aww dear.. thank you... but you shouldn't have wasted money on dress for me... I brought my own.
Bantu: No wasting miss.... you taught us free tuition, and would never accept any money even... so, these dresses are like gifts....
Dhika: smiling.... okay dear... give me the dress....
Dhika wanting to honor her promise,... stood up to receive the dress they had for her....
It was Bobby who came forward and gave her a pair of jean shorts and a white top.... Dhika was glad it was nothing bad.... and went inside to change.....

Only when she went into the dressing room and opened it,,... she saw that the shorts were ultra sort.... Upon wearing it... she saw that it hardly covered her panty.... it was super short... her entire milk thighs were visible....
The full handed top, on the other hand was okay but a little tight, .........and it ran only till the top of her stomach... her entire tummy was visible....
But upon wearing the dress... Dhika loved it.... Along with free hair,......she felt like a college teen from the movie....
Giggling,,... she came outside....
Dhika: whose idea was to get me into this dress..... she giggled...
Bobby: slowly raised his hands.....
Bobby thought that he is going to get some snarky comments.... but was surprised when Dhika came towards him........ and hugging him... she gave a thick kiss on his cheeks.....
Dhika: thanks for making me feel young again dear.... she giggled.....
Bantu: uhnnn, a kiss for mee???.......
Dhika: dutt... hehe.....
Bobby: you like the dress miss....
Dhika: yes sweetie... just that it is very smalll... and make my....... she stopped mid-sentence and put her tongue out....
Both Bobby and Bantu looked at Dhika, looking in the mirror at herself and looking at her butt......
Bantu: makes your butt look cute miss ?
Dhika: aiii.... hehe... no, make it,... jutting ,... but not like Stacy's...
Bobby: hehe...
Dhika: you too liked her.... bum... bobby ?
Bantu: not as much as we like yours....
Dhika: aiiii... enough.. hehe....stop looking at my bum.....
Dhika: and... I am not coming out in this dress... it is so small......
Bantu: uhnnn... miss look outside... it is not India.. no one will care much.. pleassseeeee
After a few moments of pestering.... she agreed....

They went and roamed the beautiful streets beneath their stay... it was clam and quiet... with less people.... They all enjoyed a cone of ice cream.... and then, soon, they were in front of a small clothing store....
Bantu: miss... lets go in.. we want to buy some dress.....
Saying, he caught her hand and led her inside...
The boys were checking shirts to wear for the office,... while Dhika was casually browsing...... when suddenly Bantu came to her....
Bantu: miss... try this shirt and pant.....
Dhika: seeing the black formal shirt... she liked it... ooh, to office ? I have never wore full formal pant shirt before.... let me try...
Dhika went into the dressing room... But unlike common stalls,.. here, instead of a door,.. there was just a screen....
Since it was a small store, and they being the only customers there... Dhika made Bantu stand guard, and went inside and closed the screen......
She removed her shorts and Top and then, tried the pant first...........it was too tight.... it wouldn't even cross her thick thighs....
Dhika: Bantu dear... can you please get the next size pants.....
Bantu: okay miss... saying he moved to get it.....
Meanwhile... Dhika wore the new shirt and just started putting one button from the bottom....... when suddenly, the screen opened.....
It was Bantu......
Dhika: seeing Bantu.... aiiiii.... .her eyes widened... and guessing how she may look now... her face blushed....

Dhika was standing there in a pink bra and a matching pink panty.... with a half worn black shirt... At the sudden entry of Bantu... she brought her one hand down to cover the front of her panty... While her entire back was visible to Bantu.....
Bantu saw the cute ass cheeks hidden inside a pink panty.....
Dhika: donkey.... what are you doing... she asked in a playful shy anger...
Bantu: miss... you only asked to bring a pant...... he blinked....
Dhika: dutt... go.. she shushed him... and closed the screen behind.......
She wore her own dress again and came out.... hitting Bantu with the pants she was holding....... Bantu laughed and ran around the store to get away from her.....
They all bought a few clothes.... boys a few unknown to Dhika and, Dhika, particularly feeling naughty.... a few dresses unknown to the boys, and then they all left the store.....
It was around 6.30 PM,... when they found a nice road side street vendor, and were having food,....... when out of nowhere, it started drizzling....
Not wanting to get caught in the rain... they gulped the food,... paid the vendor, and started walking fast towards their stay....

They were so close to the stay,... when a sudden crashing sound cracked the sky open and heavy downpour started..... In a matter of seconds, all 3 were drenched to their bones.... Worse was that the temperature of the earlier pleasant evening vanished, and a chill cold crept into their bodies....
All 3 ran, and soon reached their room... and standing in the kitchen, they stood dripping wet... shivering....
Looking at the boys shivering... she became very worried,..... and ignoring her own cold, she turned and caught hold of Bantu's hands and started rubbing it against her own.....
While she warmed Bantu... she suddenly saw how Bobby was shivering beyond control....
Dhika: oh Bobby... come here... quick.....
She left Bantu and moved to Bobby, rubbing his cheeks with her hands....,.... but soon she realized this rubbing is working faster as she wanted it to.
Dhika: Bantu... switch on the AC to regulate room temperature.....
Dhika: oh no,.. this too won't work faster....
So many scenarios ran in the maternal mind... when suddenly,... something clicked her......

Leaving Bobby and Bantu to stand there,... she rushed and ran towards the bathroom.... and with the same momentum, the next second, she came back running... and, without so much as telling them anything, she started removing Bobby's T shirt.......
Bantu just stood there,,... shivering and blinking at her......
Dhika: Bantu, remove your shirt and pant, at once, nowww.... she said to him a stern tone...
Little startled,... Bantu started removing his shirt and then his pants..... while Dhika herself sat down in front of Bobby and started removing his pants.....
Dhika was still in her white top, which now was completely drenched and fully transparent,.... and jean shorts.... while Bobby was down to his boxers, and Bantu in his vest and boxers.....
Standing up,... Dhika held the boys hands and ran towards the bathroom..... and pushed them into the shower....
And she too got in.......
The hot water from the shower felt sooooo soothing.....
